title: 30 day review of the Winspace T1600.

takeaways.text: After 30 days with 30 mm front and 32 mm rear tires the owner found it smooth, stiff, firm and responsive, and liked the finish.

He found the front end jittery and unsettling when descending fast or riding at 25–30 mph and blames the fork geometry, independent of the 67 mm wheels' crosswind effect; this conflicts with another reviewer who found it very stable.
The Hyper bar's swept-back aero drops left him without a solid, comfortable grip in the drops, though the tops felt great.

disclosure: The owner bought the complete bike at a clearance price; the description mentions no sponsorship.
summary: Owner's 30-day impressions of a Dura-Ace T1600 with Hyper D67 wheels and the Hyper integrated bar, ridden five days a week, plus a ceramic paint-coating aside.
